stories.title: Joint exercises and firepower
stories.body: KHANJAR-XIII (India–Kyrgyzstan, Missamari, Feb 4–17); DHARMA GUARDIAN 7th (India–Japan, Chaubattia, Feb 24–Mar 9); VAJRA PRAHAR 16th (India–US, Bakloh, Feb 23–Mar 15); IAF's Vayushakti-26 at Pokhran (Feb 27); INS Anjadip (3rd ASW-SWC, GRSE) commissioned; CTS 'Krishna' launched at L&T Kattupalli.
